description: This file contains extension methods for configuring dependency injection in the Orleans project, specifically for registering existing service implementations within the IServiceCollection.

classes.name: ServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate registration of existing service implementations.

methods.name: AddFromExisting
methods.description: Registers an existing implementation of TImplementation as a provider of TService in the service collection.

methods.name: AddFromExisting
methods.description: Registers an existing registration of a service type with a specific implementation type.

methods.name: TryAddFromExisting
methods.description: Registers an existing implementation of TImplementation as a provider of TService only if no other implementations of TService are already registered.
